scope: Native HaMeR/WiLoR quality under same input, hand-root/OpenPose21 output contract; not full type matrix, temporal benchmark or framework speed claim

corpus.scope: Small static image-pose pilot through real video interfaces; frame1 scored once per source image

primary_scoring: Preregistered exact source-frame scoring; missing frame1 is a native coverage miss

frame_binding.method: Actual stock sampling PTS and lexical filenames plus decoded pixel comparison; no pose labels used

audit.validity: Production contracts and checked exports; accuracy and downstream usefulness unlabelled
Finite 21x3 predictions only; native model differs, no pose-accuracy or coordinate-equivalence guarantee

fixed_model_execution_track.stage_interface: left/right Dex six rows each exact; existing baseline acceptance

limits: Pilot subset, no general accuracy/speed superiority conclusion.
Source images may be correlated; image count is not independent subject/capture count.
PA alignment removes scale/orientation/translation; it does not validate metric world pose.
Conditional pose errors are accompanied by all-GT coverage and quality yield.
Model/resource/output scopes differ; end-to-end time is a native product observation.
Only 12 seeded FreiHAND eval images; not an independently audited egocentric/temporal holdout.
EgoWorld receives an all-right task prior; WiLoR detects side. Side accuracy not equally informed.
Task-configured native DJ chain: duration/resolution/hand OP, frame_num36; no stationary-rejecting motion filter. Original CPU/device/resource/cache/error/mesh/vis defaults preserved.
EgoWorld splits into twelve three-frame clips; native WiLoR handles all frames of one row. Extra work and startup/residency costs differ.
Native CPU-only Torch baseline versus local RTX4060 CUDA; no server scaling conclusion.
Success-run wall times exclude dataset preparation and prior interrupted attempt; all known interruption records retained.
No physical metric world-coordinate, mesh-accuracy, robot-task or training-usefulness claim.
FreiHAND has one annotated target; extras are off-target predictions for this task, not a claim of exhaustive generic hand-detection FP labels.
posthoc_auxiliary_policy: Image-equivalence only, verified repeated RGB pixels; not preregistered; primary exact-frame result unchanged.

retained_binding_failures.reason: Initial ordinal-as-source-frame assumption failed pixel verification; scorer then refused missing corpus. Corrected with native PTS and separate frame views; no model rerun.
